metadata.title: Public-domain authored-writings acquisition targets for the 55 Federal Convention delegates
metadata.purpose: Map each delegate to the best public-domain edition of their OWN writings (letters, papers, speeches, essays) to ingest, plus surname-collision risk and surviving-papers tier. Drives scripts/build_delegate_acquisition_matrix.py.
metadata.notes: internet_archive identifiers are candidate djvu.txt sources for scripts/ingest. Where survival is minimal or only copyrighted modern editions exist, that is recorded explicitly. collision_word=true means the surname is a common English word or extremely common name, so bare-surname mention counts are unreliable.
